data_fields.name: cue_at_s
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 after start (widget, at end of hold); timeoutSec - 3 (QML)

data_fields.name: window_s
data_fields.donor_constant: server timeoutSec (no client constant in donor)

best_idea: Show a server-opened decision window as a bar that holds for a short grace, drains linearly to the server deadline on the client clock, cues once at the start of the drain, and ends when the server says so, never when the client timer runs out.
decision_why: The shape suits a timed decision in a fast duel, but the 3 s hold is a poker-table choice and must become data with a small default, and the donor's two cue points must become one rule.
acceptance: In a server-opened window of N s, the local bar sits full for the grace, drains linearly to empty at the server deadline, plays one cue at the start of the drain, and disappears when the server closes the window; a unit test asserts the fraction stays in 0..1 for any elapsed time and the cue fires once.
